messages.content:
Here is an image inspired by the dad joke: "You will never guess what Elsa did to the balloon. She let it go."

![Dad Joke Image](https://oaidalleapiprodscus.blob.core.windows.net/private/org-wxuM2WgO1XOxPgxJD7bt8HR1/user-XVmRbskU1sFwpHcVzNUhuelb/img-3TCLLJxBGPwsp4z25ISzd3Uk.png?st=2026-01-13T17%3A47%3A48Z&se=2026-01-13T19%3A47%3A48Z&sp=r&sv=2024-08-04&sr=b&rscd=inline&rsct=image/png&skoid=35890473-cca8-4a54-8305-05a39e0bc9c3&sktid=a48cca56-e6da-484e-a814-9c849652bcb3&skt=2026-01-13T17%3A51%3A36Z&ske=2026-01-14T17%3A51%3A36Z&sks=b&skv=2024-08-04&sig=CJd301T35wiqp477qhZbZasSfKawolP7so6qlW9/Qnc%3D)

The joke plays on the popular song "Let It Go" from the Disney movie *Frozen*, which features the character Elsa. In the context of the joke, it humorously suggests that instead of "letting it go" in a metaphorical sense (as in letting go of worries or fears), Elsa literally lets go of a balloon. The humor comes from the unexpected twist of taking a well-known phrase and applying it to a silly situation.
